thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-1950 — Inference-serving: elevated 95th p99 latency in us-west-2 (auto-escalation)

maya: Got the page, I'm looking. seeing a spike in p99 on the grafana chart for 'redwood/serve/u-west2' right now.

own: I'm on VPN, can repro the tail latency in the loadtest dashboard. Might be retry storm from a small customer?

sara: Did PD show any recent deploys?

paul: No deploys in the last 30m, CI shows last rollout 2h ago.

incident-bot: PagerDuty details: severity=high, triggered_by=error-rate-rule, escalated_to=ops-oncall -> ops-lead.

maya: Quick check — are we in the maintenance quiet window for snapshot backups? I see a cron job kicking off at 23:00 UTC.

own: yes, nightly-blob-sync started 23:01 UTC on the nodes. But it shouldn't affect latency normally.

raj: Oncall handoff: @owen do you want to take initial ack? ops-oncall is tagged in PD but hasn't acked.

own: I'll ack and take it. acking now.

own: acked INC-1950, I'm running the health checks and tail logs.

maya: Thanks. While you dig, quick customer impact check: any 500s or user-facing errors?

own: Looking at logs: 502 spikes on the grpc gateway for a small set of customers (customer_ids: [C-843, C-219]). Mostly timeouts upstream.

paul: Can you paste the relevant snippet from the gateway logs?

own: ```
2026-03-14T23:02:15Z gateway srv: request timeout for req_id=abc123 customer=C-843 route=/v1/generate status=504 duration_ms=45000
2026-03-14T23:02:18Z gateway srv: retrying upstream req_id=abc124
2026-03-14T23:02:20Z worker-12: kvcache: eviction pressure at 87%
```

maya: KV cache eviction pressure climbing is suspicious — could be memory pressure causing longer GC pauses on one host class.

raj: Ops-bot runbook check: which playbook covers high p99 in inference?

ops-bot: Runbook reference: https://confluence.redwood/ops/inference-latency. Steps: 1) Check node-level memory/temp, 2) Check autoscale pools, 3) Fallback to smaller model.

own: Running node checks now. `kubectl top pods -n redwood` shows worker-12 at 98% CPU and 92% memory. A few others at 60-70%.

paul: Any noisy tenants pinned to worker-12?

maya: Cross-checking placement logs: C-843 and C-219 are colocated on worker-12 due to previous affinity. That explains localized effect.

raj: For mitigation, we can 1) cordon and drain worker-12 (slow), 2) scale up worker pool (fast if autoscale available), 3) route affected tenants to fallback model with lower memory pressure. Thoughts?

own: I'm going to temporarily scale up the dedicated pool by +2 nodes to relieve pressure. Executing autoscale now.

own: `infractl scale pool inference-prod-usw2 --add 2` -> submitted.

ops-bot: Autoscale request acknowledged, new nodes expected in ~90s.

maya: Also recommend applying a targeted route override for C-843/C-219 to fallback-model-quantized for 10m. That cuts memory by 40%.

paul: Do we have permission to change routing for those tenants? That would be an app-level change with potential output quality tradeoffs. We need PD owner ok.

own: I'm owner for this PD. I approve temporary route override. Applying now. `redwoodctl routes switch --tenant C-843 --model fallback-quantized --ttl 600`

own: applied for C-843 and C-219. Monitoring impact.

maya: Nice. Any drop in gateway 500s?

own: Early signs good — 504s for those tenants dropped to baseline. p99 across cluster decreased from 3.2s -> 0.9s.

raj: Customer impact: limited to two customers, degraded latency for a few minutes before auto-ackmitigation. No broad outage. We should notify support to proactively message affected customers.

paul: I'll ping support. @sara please draft a short note: what happened, who was affected, and current mitigation steps.

sara: On it. Draft: "We detected elevated latency affecting a small subset of customers in us-west-2. We've rerouted traffic for the affected tenants to a quantized fallback model and scaled capacity; latency has returned to normal. We're investigating root cause (KV cache eviction + node memory pressure) and will follow up with a timeline."

maya: Thanks. follow-up next steps: 1) run `heapdump` on worker-12 (after it's drained), 2) check scheduler for future affinity placements that pin noisy tenants, 3) add alert for kvcache eviction >80% with node label.

own: I'll keep the PD incident open for 30m and then transition to post-incident analysis if stable.

incident-bot: Incidents note: INC-1950 acknowledged by owen. Status=mitigated (autoscale + routing override).

paul: Marking owner: owen. Handoff plan: if latency reoccurs, escalate to ops-lead and mobilize live rollback of last config changes.

raj: Agree. Adding retrospective owners: maya (infra root cause), owen (mitigation steps), sara (customer comms).

own: closing loop — p99 stable for 8 mins, will keep watch and then hand off to maya for RCA.

maya: thx all.

incident-bot: INC-1950 status changed to resolved at 1950124102 (automated update).
